reviews.text:
As I was about to enter the store, the female staff member immediately asked me, "Does your dog pee? Yes, pee. Does your dog have an accident? If so..." I was taken aback. I've been there many times, but I've never been told such a rule, and my dog ​​has never had an accident in this store.

Even though I buy things here every time, this kind of treatment was a first for me, and I was quite shocked.

Isn't "accident" a term used when the person who caused the accident (not just peeing) apologizes...?

I'm left with a lingering feeling of unease.

As an ordinary person, I only buy a small 10g pack as a souvenir for my beloved cat when I stop by Omotesando.

Even though I only buy a small amount because my cat mainly eats dry food from another manufacturer, the staff are always very kind.
They carefully explained the product's features to me.
Thank you for your always courteous service ＼(^o^)／ It's great that we can also sample snacks and food.

This food is good for my dog's health, so I rotate his food with this one. I like that every time I go to the store to buy food, the staff are always so kind and helpful, and they always give me advice. Thanks to this food, his coat is shiny and healthy.

[An essential shop for your dog's health]

I have a miniature schnauzer, and since switching to K9 Natural food, his coat has become noticeably shinier and he's dandruff-free!

He also no longer suffers from diarrhea, and despite his age, he's been walking more and becoming more energetic.

He no longer needs to go to the vet, so I've truly realized that a dog's health starts with their diet!

This store also offers tastings, so if the timing is right, I recommend trying them out and choosing the food that's right for your dog!

However, my dog ​​ate every variety, changing the color of his eyes, so I decided it didn't matter what kind I tried, lol.

I recommended this food to my dog-loving friends and they said it was expensive, but since you only feed him about half the amount of other foods, it's actually only a little pricey.

This food has dramatically improved my dog's health, so I seriously recommend it to all dog lovers!

This shop is essential for my dog's life.
I buy a different flavor every month on a rotation basis.
The staff are all kind and friendly.
I'm also happy that points accumulate quickly! ✨
I was able to choose the perfect food for my dog. I will come back when I run out of food.

A plastic-like object was found mixed in with the product I purchased.

I contacted them, and the matter ended with a brief apology, a replacement can, and the problematic plastic being mailed to me for investigation.

However, I still can't accept this, thinking about what might have happened if I had unknowingly given it to someone.

Do they really think that replacing only one can and apologizing is enough? I also have some doubts about their emphasis on the fact that it wasn't domestically produced.

Regardless of the production location, shouldn't safety be guaranteed?

I've been using K9's food for a while, but I wasn't sure which one to choose and was worried about whether it was really right for my dog, so I decided to visit the physical store.
The store was clean, and the staff were friendly and easy to talk to, and were very helpful in giving me advice!
Since switching to this food, his coat has lost a lot of its luster, so I wanted to try out different products, but I wasn't sure if they would suit my dog's palate, so being able to sample them was a very appreciated service. After listening to all the information, I was able to purchase the supplements and lamb food, and I'm looking forward to what's to come.
My dog ​​won't eat it if I soak it, but he eats it incredibly fast if I give it to him without soaking it. Is it okay to let him eat it like this without soaking it?

When the female staff member offered samples, she was very strict with my dog, refusing to give him any until he sat down. I felt very uncomfortable that she was giving samples to her own dog and other dogs without making them sit. Later, when I mentioned this to an employee at another pet shop, they said, "I've never heard of a store employee making a customer's dog sit down before giving them a sample!" Moreover, my dog ​​is really well-behaved, so I don't understand what they didn't like about him.

This is Pomeranian, a former rescue dog. After Cushing's disease and bladder stone tests, she came in a very gray area, and the vet suggested we start by improving her diet. An acquaintance recommended K9 food, so I decided to visit the shop. They let us sample all the varieties, and even my picky Pomeranian seemed to enjoy picking and choosing from them. The shop staff were very knowledgeable about the relationship between illness and food, which gave me a great sense of reassurance. They even opened canned food on the spot and let us sample it—it was more than just a sample! They also taught us about the balance between palatability and what's good for her health, which was incredibly helpful. Thanks to Oto-chan, who was also working as the shop's mascot dog, for playing with us. We'll be back soon. Thank you again.
